preview.label: Preview row limit
preview.description: Maximum number of rows to show in transform previews. Higher values may slow down previews for complex expressions.

analytics.label: Opt out of analytics
analytics.description: Syto uses GoatCounter, a privacy-respecting analytics service (no cookies, GDPR-compliant). You can opt out at any time. Your preference is stored locally in your browser.

experimental.label: Experimental
experimental.description: Transform engine — DuckDB runs supported transforms via SQL in a Web Worker. Unsupported transforms automatically fall back to Arquero.

note: Some interface elements use the primary theme color. The "Syto" theme also uses custom typography and removes border radiuses for a sharper look.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: This will permanently delete all sources, models, and steps from your browser's storage. This action cannot be undone.
